etymology: Phono-semantic: rain/sky (雨) + 辰 (phonetic シン) — the sky's tremor brought to earth: to quake, shake.
mnemonic: The storm that shakes from below instead — ふるえる. 地震: the kanji Japan checks its phone for.

etymology: Compound ideograph: mouth (口) + 欠 'wide open' — breath pushed out: to blow.
mnemonic: Cheeks full, candles doomed — ふく. 吹奏楽: blowing, organized into a band.

etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 生 'born' (phonetic セイ) — the name of one's birth-line (the oldest clans traced through mothers): surname.
mnemonic: The name you were born already carrying — セイ. 姓名: surname first, in Japan as in the kanji.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the diviner reading cracks (卜) and pronouncing (口) — to divine; to claim the spot the omen names: to occupy.
mnemonic: Read the crack, call the future, plant the flag — うらなう, しめる. 占い at the corner; 独占 in the boardroom.

etymology: Compound ideograph (simplified from 雙): two hands — a matched two: a pair, twin.
mnemonic: Two right hands, identical — ソウ. 双子: the kanji looking in a mirror.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 叟 (phonetic ソウ — an elder with a torch indoors) — hunting by torchlight: to search.
mnemonic: Torch in one hand, the other feeling the dark — さがす. 捜査: searching with a warrant.

etymology: Compound ideograph: hand (扌) + broom (帚) — the broom at work: to sweep.
mnemonic: Hand meets broom, dust loses — はく. 掃除: the weekend's opening ceremony.

etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 喿 (phonetic ソウ) — dried by heat until it crackles: to parch.
mnemonic: So dry it sings like birds in a dead tree — ソウ. 乾燥: winter air, skin's enemy.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 曽 (phonetic ゾウ) — resentment layered on resentment: to hate.
mnemonic: Grudges stacked like steamer trays — にくむ. 憎い: the dish that took years to cook.

etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 曽 (phonetic ゾウ) — value handed over in layers of wrapping: to present, bestow.
mnemonic: The gift wrapped one layer per bow — おくる. 贈り物: generosity, laminated.

etymology: Compound: one man stepping in as another steps out (夫夫) — a swap declared (曰): to exchange, substitute.
mnemonic: Shift change at the counter — かえる. 両替: money's version; 着替え: your wardrobe's.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 代 (phonetic タイ) + garment (衣) — cloth sewn to carry: a bag, a sack.
mnemonic: Clothing for objects — ふくろ. 手袋: bags for hands — gloves, adorably.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 翟 (phonetic タク) — cloth beaten and rinsed like a bird bathing: to wash, rinse.
mnemonic: The washing thrashing like wings in the tub — タク. 洗濯: the machine still imitates the bird.

etymology: Compound ideograph: ear (耳) + heart (心) — the heart heard in the burning ears: shame.
mnemonic: Ears red before the mind admits it — はずかしい. 恥ずかしい: biology outing you.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 遲): movement (辶) + a phonetic — dragging along the road: slow, late.
mnemonic: A sheep on a leash setting the pace — おそい, おくれる. 遅刻: the sheep wins again.

etymology: Compound: what the field (田) stores and raises (玄, accumulation) — animals kept: livestock.
mnemonic: The farm's walking inventory — チク. 家畜: the animals with jobs.

etymology: Phono-semantic: horse (馬) + 主 (phonetic チュウ) — the horse halted at the master's post: to station, park.
mnemonic: Tie the horse where the lamp burns — チュウ. 駐車場: the hitching post, paved.

etymology: Phono-semantic: run (走) + 召 (phonetic チョウ) — leaping clear over: to exceed, transcend; the prefix 'ultra-'.
mnemonic: Called, and you clear the bar entirely — こえる. 超いい: slang's favorite kanji since the 90s.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 冘 (phonetic チン) — pulled under: to sink, to brood.
mnemonic: Weight on the ankles, water closing over — しずむ. 沈黙: conversation doing the same.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 㐱 (phonetic チン) — a gem seldom seen: rare, precious, curious.
mnemonic: The stone the collector has never managed to buy — めずらしい. 珍しい: the eyebrow-raise kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 尼 (phonetic デイ) — earth and water settled together: mud.
mnemonic: Water that gave up moving — どろ. 泥棒: the thief, forever tracked by it.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 啇 (phonetic テキ) — water falling bead by bead: a drop, to drip.
mnemonic: The faucet's midnight metronome — しずく. 一滴: one bead of anything precious.

etymology: Compound: the great guarded hall — palace; the address written to its occupant: 〜殿.
mnemonic: The building with its own honorific — との, デン. 宮殿: the hall; 田中殿: the letterhead bow.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 涂 (phonetic ト) + earth (土) — mud spread on walls: to plaster, paint, smear.
mnemonic: Trowel the wet earth smooth — ぬる. ペンキ塗りたて: wet paint, the bench's warning.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 度 (phonetic ト) — going across the water: to cross; passing something across: to hand over.
mnemonic: Ford the river, parcel held high — わたる, わたす. 横断歩道's cousin: every crossing is a 渡り.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 余 (phonetic ト) — the road underway: route, course.
mnemonic: The part of the journey you're still inside — ト. 途中: mid-road, where everything interesting happens.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 奴 (phonetic ド) + heart (心) — the heart driven like a slave: rage.
mnemonic: The heart worked past its limit snaps — おこる. 怒る: management by volcano.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 到 (phonetic トウ) — a person brought down: to topple, collapse.
mnemonic: Timber, but for people and governments — たおれる. 面倒: the fallen thing you now must lift.

etymology: Phono-semantic: ice (冫) + 東 (phonetic トウ) — locked in ice: to freeze.
mnemonic: The east wind files everything under ice — こおる. 冷凍: the freezer aisle's kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 荅 (phonetic トウ) — coined to transcribe Sanskrit 'stupa': the pagoda, any tower.
mnemonic: The word built to hold a borrowed building — トウ. 東京タワー's ancestor: 五重塔.

etymology: Compound: drooling (次) over another's dish (皿) — desire acted on: to steal.
mnemonic: Eyeing the plate one table over, then taking it — ぬすむ. 強盗: the impatient version.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 同 (phonetic トウ) — the bamboo tube: a cylinder, a pipe.
mnemonic: Bamboo's natural product: the tube — つつ. 封筒: the envelope, a flattened one.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 至 'reach' + 刂 (phonetic トウ) — getting all the way there: arrival.
mnemonic: The arrow hits the floor point-down: here — トウ. 到着: wheels touching tarmac.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 兆 (phonetic トウ) — reading the omen and running: to flee.
mnemonic: See the cracks forming and go — にげる. 逃げる: wisdom, at speed.

etymology: Compound: bursting from the hole (穴) — a dog springing out: sudden thrust: to pierce, to jut.
mnemonic: Out of the burrow, straight at you — つく. 突然: the kanji with no warning label.

etymology: Compound ideograph: sun (日) + cloud (雲) — the sun filed behind clouds: overcast.
mnemonic: Sun present but unavailable — くもり. The forecast's middle child: 晴れ, 曇り, 雨.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 屯 (phonetic ドン) — a blade gone soft: dull, slow.
mnemonic: The knife that squashes tomatoes — にぶい. 鈍行: the train equivalent, stopping everywhere.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 欠 (phonetic ナン) — a ride cushioned soft: soft, pliable.
mnemonic: Suspension that yawns over bumps — やわらかい's formal cousin, ナン. 柔軟: flexibility, doubled.

etymology: Phono-semantic: beast (犭) + 苗 (phonetic ビョウ — near the meow) — the animal that guards the seedlings from mice: the cat.
mnemonic: The beast hired by the rice sprouts — ねこ. 猫: paid in fish, works when it feels like it.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + the brain phonetic — the head churning the heart: to worry, be troubled.
mnemonic: Brain and heart arguing after midnight — なやむ. 悩み: the meeting with no agenda that never ends.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 農 (phonetic ノウ) — liquid thick with substance: concentrated, dark, dense.
mnemonic: The broth boiled down to its argument — こい. 濃い coffee, 濃い relationships: both keep you up.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 不 (phonetic ハイ) — the wooden wine cup: a cup; the counter for cupfuls.
mnemonic: The cup that says 'not empty yet' — ハイ. 乾杯: making it empty anyway; 一杯: one more.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 白 (phonetic ハク) — the boat moored in shallow clear water for the night: to lodge, stay over.
mnemonic: Anchor down where the water shows white sand — とまる. 二泊三日: two anchorings, three days.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 溥 (phonetic ハク) — spread thin as marsh grass on water: thin, weak, pale.
mnemonic: One layer stretched to cover too much — うすい. 薄い tea, 薄い excuses: same transparency.
